name: Exploding text
what: A line of glowing fire-coloured capitals types itself on in the middle of a dark scene, holds, then blows apart: every letter tumbles out across the whole frame, drifting to rest, shrinking and fading, changing colour from gold to red as it drops.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f1-f30 the line types on letter by letter (about 1.5 f a letter); f31-f49 it holds; f50 the letters smear and twist; f51-f56 they fly most of the way out across the frame; f56-f80 they drift the last bit and stop (a fast burst, then a long soft end); f60-f97 they shrink to ~0.6 and fade out; each letter's colour follows its height in the frame (gold above the middle, red below)

tracks.name: type on
tracks.what: the line types on letter by letter

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: the glowing line holds while the grid sways
